name: Crowley JAXPORT Terminal Office #2 - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: 1163 Talleyrand Ave = Crowley Port Office #2, southern end of the Talleyrand terminal complex. Roster geocode movedMeters null (low precision). Confirmed via satellite + Street View: a fenced container yard with a long warehouse (the ~10,000 sqft warehouse Crowley lists) and a 'CROWLEY' sign on Talleyrand Ave. Office #2 handles Puerto Rico, Breakbulk, Car Haulers, Cross Dock, vehicle receiving.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in Street View 2025-02: a swing/slide gate in the chain-link fence line on Talleyrand Ave, truck observed passing through; 'NO STANDING' sign posted on the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth/kiosk structure with a canopy sits beside the gate (visible in Street View and as a small white structure in z21). Modest footprint; classified guardShack true given port TWIC access control, but the structure is small - flagged uncertain (could be an unmanned kiosk).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a booth structure is present; flagged uncertain - if the booth is an unmanned kiosk, remoteGs would be true instead.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate opens directly onto Talleyrand Avenue, a two-lane through road with a 'NO STANDING' sign - little room to queue without spilling onto the road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long warehouse with loading doors on the yard-facing side; ~8 estimated, low confidence (port warehouse, not a standard dock bank).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Container/trailer yard holds several dozen trailers and container stacks; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single gate opening; ~1 in / 1 out (shared). Counts low confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: Web profile mentions scales at the broader Talleyrand terminal, but none clearly resolved at this Office #2 gate - left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Heavy rail yards run immediately west/southwest of the property; spurs serve the Talleyrand terminal complex.
